bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears are riding high after dominating the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks 34-17 on Monday Night Football, with new defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons rewarding the Bears, who traded two first-round picks for him last week, with a spectacular debut that had wide-ranging impact in their 34-17 victory. The win has sparked widespread buzz about Chicago's Super Bowl potential, with the Bears now sitting at 5-2 and reportedly in the market for secondary help as the trade deadline approaches, with insider Jordan Schultz noting a potential reunion with Khalil Mack.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: Linebacker Jack Campbell remained hospitalized after being injured on a routine tackle on Minnesota tight end T.J. Hockenson during the first play of the fourth quarter in Detroit's 19-15 win over the Vikings , with the team saying he continues to rest and recover at a local hospital .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers bolstered their roster this week, signing EDGE D.J. Johnson, QB Cam Miller and S John Saunders Jr.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings fell to 6-1 after a tough 19-15 loss to the Lions, with kicker Will Reichard missing his sole field-goal attempt in a four-point game that went down to the wire . Amid the setback, a reported trade sending receiver Jauan Jennings back to San Francisco collapsed after Jennings made it clear he didn't want to go back , while the Vikings also made roster moves by releasing guard Trevor Keegan as they eye potential trade deadline additions like running back Jonathan Taylor.
